tion spends on MCPJam-billed\nwork — chat, evals, judges and computer time — for each billing period, from\n**Organization → Budge

t**.

* Set the cap in dollars, and choose the percentages to be warned at. The
 default warns at 80%; reaching the cap always

notifies, whether or not you
 list it.
* Warnings go to the organization's owners and admins in the notifications
 bell, and
to the owner by email.\n* **When the budget is reached**, new chat turns, eval runs and computer starts\n are refused for the wh
ole organization. The refusal says the budget is\n reached and that an owner or admin can raise it — buying credits does not\n c
lear it. Work already in flight finishes, and running computers keep going\n until they hibernate.\n* A scheduled eval that hits
the budget pauses its schedule rather than\n retrying into the same cap every window; it resumes once you raise the cap or\n the
period rolls over.\n* Runs that use **your own API keys** are never counted against the budget and\n never blocked by it. Neithe
r is the free daily allowance, which is not\n credits.\n* The window is your organization's own billing period: the subscription
cycle\n for team and enterprise plans, and the calendar month otherwise. Raising or\n lowering the cap mid-period does not reset

what has already been spent.

Any member can see the budget and how much of it is left; only owners and
admins can change it.

Every change is recorded in the organization's audit log
with who made it and what it was before.

The same budget is readable

and writable from the API at
`/v1/organizations/{organizationId}/spend-budget`.
